documents.text: Inspect analytics.sqlite and calculate total amount_cents for orders whose status is paid. Return the integer as length for id paid_total.
Inspect analytics.sqlite and calculate total amount_cents for orders whose status is refunded. Return the integer as length for id refunded_total.
Inspect analytics.sqlite and render the required paid amount_cents by region bar chart. Return its pointCount as length for id paid_region_chart_points.
